about: What changed on nfs4.xyz, day by day. Kinds: new, improved, fixed. Days run 05:00 to 05:00 Polish time. nfs3-webgl's tools/discord/changelog.mjs posts them to Discord.

items: Discord server for help, bug reports, ideas and finding races: linked in the menu and in the beta note.
What's New: this list of changes, day by day.
A new look: a lo-fi start page with a new emblem and icons.
An early beta notice, with where to report problems.
Smoother menus: the game's threads take turns by priority, as on Windows 98, and file lookups are much faster.
Smoother online races and steadier frame pacing, from NFS3 Web.
First version: Need for Speed: High Stakes (with VEG's Modern Patch) recompiled to WebAssembly. Bring your own game folder; it never leaves your browser.
Online races in the browser over the game's LAN (IPX) mode.
